manual_review.duplicate_policy: Keep the frozen 105-case list; group duplicate image sequences for agreement/confusion and any calibration/holdout partition. Adjudicate contradictory human verdicts; never count duplicates as independent samples.
manual_review.required_human_action: Review the 105 cases and export annotations_human.csv with PASS/FAIL/UNCERTAIN, reviewer ID and UTC time. The agent has not created human labels.
manual_review.after_labels: Evaluate frozen FOV-v2 against independent human verdicts first; report FP/FN/UNCERTAIN and duplicate-group counts. Only then decide and freeze deterministic FOV-v3 and re-audit all provisional evidence.

capacity_decision.interpretation: 1005 is the capacity of the enumerated 71-scene pool under frozen static filters and exclusions, not proof of the capacity of all InteriorGS or continuous pose space.
capacity_decision.recommended_expansion: Expand an explicitly train-only scene registry beyond the old-v46 scene roster, with authoritative split provenance and all frozen-eval exclusions; enumerate metadata with unchanged static filters before budgeting generation. Do not duplicate rows or treat weights as new data.
capacity_decision.secondary_option: Opposite Projective relations are distinct task lineages only after separate certificates and RGB validation; they do not add object pairs and cannot address the FOV deficit. Do not launch such expansion until the retry is reconciled and the next scope is frozen.
